mutations.name: CX-DOCDATA-VERDICT
mutations._mechanism: Listed doc/data must skip judging even when its test is absent.

mutations.name: CX-DOCDATA-DIRECTORY
mutations._mechanism: An empty identity name set must skip before names[0] is accessed.

mutations.name: CX-NOT-CODE-LIKE
mutations._mechanism: Test-shaped Python must not enter the non-Python listing path.
mutations.find: if resolved.names and all(Path(fold_py_suffix(n)).suffix == ".py" for n in resolved.names):  # M:CX-NOT-CODE-LIKE

mutations.name: CX-NOT-CODE-LIKE-ALL
mutations._mechanism: A listed non-.py file reached through a same-directory test-shaped .py hard link is judged; only an all-.py name set skips the listing path (2026-11-08, Claude parity).
mutations.find: if resolved.names and all(Path(fold_py_suffix(n)).suffix == ".py" for n in resolved.names):  # M:CX-NOT-CODE-LIKE
mutations.replace: if resolved.names and any(Path(fold_py_suffix(n)).suffix == ".py" for n in resolved.names):  # M:CX-NOT-CODE-LIKE

mutations.name: CX-LIST-EXEMPT
mutations._mechanism: Exempt locations must skip judging listed targets.

mutations.name: CX-CHAIN-UNREADABLE
mutations._mechanism: Unreadable governing state must deny with judge-error.

mutations.name: CX-LIST-UNREADABLE
mutations._mechanism: Undecidable listing must deny with judge-error.

mutations.name: CX-VERDICT
mutations._mechanism: A DENY judge verdict must propagate to the caller.

mutations.name: CX-DENY
mutations._mechanism: The per-target loop must emit the listing denial.

mutations.name: CX-NOT-LISTED
mutations._mechanism: Unlisted targets must skip judging rather than pass None to the judge.

mutations.name: CX-ACTIVE
mutations._mechanism: An active chain must reach listing and judging.

mutations.name: CX-LIST-NAMES
mutations._mechanism: Codex must pass every canonical name to the listing; only the target's own name misses a listed hard link and wrongly admits the write.
mutations.find: names = [Path(resolved.target).parent / n for n in resolved.names]

mutations.name: CX-JUDGED
mutations._mechanism: Codex must judge the selected (least listed) name; judging the greatest flips selection scenarios S1 and S2 and wrongly admits S2.
mutations.replace: verdict = judge.judge(root, max(names, key=lambda p: p.name), chain.records)

mutations.name: CX-CHAIN-TARGET
mutations._mechanism: The chain is read for the target, so state nested under the target's own project governs it; a root-scoped read finds none and wrongly admits the write.
